title: v1: Swiss DEM → Garmin hillshading .IMG pipeline
description: Python orchestrator that turns a local dir of swissALTI3D GeoTIFF tiles (EPSG:2056) into a Garmin .IMG with hillshaded relief. Pipeline: gdalbuildvrt → gdalwarp (reproject 2056→4326, downsample to ~1 arc-sec, -tap) → gdal_translate -of SRTMHGT per 1° tile → synthesize minimal bounds.osm → mkgmap --dem. Shell out to GDAL CLI (not osgeo bindings). Auto-download+cache pinned mkgmap jar (SHA-verified). Java>=1.8 required. See /home/marcus/.claude/plans/we-need-digital-elevation-fizzy-hammock.md
notes: v1 pipeline implemented and verified end-to-end on synthetic EPSG:2056 DEMs (cold-cache run: download+SHA-verify mkgmap r4924 -> HGT 3601x3601 -> mkgmap --dem -> DEM-embedded .img). 14 unit tests pass (hgt tiling geometry + GDAL/mkgmap argv construction). Edge-tile margin + dstnodata voids handle mkgmap's out-of-bounds DEM border. REMAINING: manual visual confirmation on REAL swissALTI3D + BaseCamp/device (no automated substitute) before closing.
close_reason: Verified end-to-end on real swissALTI3D (0.5m) and confirmed rendering as 'topovert' on a Garmin device. Implemented in commit 1df08d1.

title: swissTLM3D vector features via ogr2pbf (+splitter)
description: Add vector map features from swissTLM3D: ogr2pbf converts OGR-readable swissTLM3D (GeoPackage) to .osm.pbf with reprojection 2056→4326; splitter tiles large extents; mkgmap compiles. Needs a tag-translation file mapping swissTLM3D attrs to OSM tags. Deferred from v1.
design: CLI-only (NOT ogr2pbf). ogr2pbf needs compiled osgeo GDAL bindings, which CLAUDE.md deliberately avoids; would drop stdlib-only/zero-dep property. Instead: ogr2ogr -f GeoJSONSeq reprojects swissTLM3D 2056->4326; new src/topovert/vector.py converts GeoJSON->OSM via a data-only TAG_MAP (unit-tested); mkgmap consumes one combined .osm. Slice 1 = core nav set: tlm_strasse->highway, tlm_fliessgewaesser->waterway, tlm_stehende_gewaesser->natural=water, tlm_gebaeude*->building. Splitter deferred.
notes: VERIFIED end-to-end against sample GDB (testdata/.../SWISSTLM3D_CHLV95LN02.gdb) + 10m DEM. Output out/swiss_tlm.img built by mkgmap with: 5862 highway ways (full motorway..path hierarchy + 1 ferry), 196 waterway lines, 36 filled water areas (TLM_BODENBEDECKUNG polys), 15422 buildings. Reconciled mapping to real data: OBJEKTART is integer (codes from swisstopo Objektkatalog), water areas from BODENBEDECKUNG not shoreline lines. 25 unit tests pass. Remaining = human visual acceptance in BaseCamp/QMapShack (load out/swiss_tlm.img). Deferred work tracked: 9t0 splitter, unr broaden TAG_MAP, ktq node dedup.
close_reason: swissTLM3D core-nav vector slice implemented (CLI-only ogr2ogr->GeoJSON->OSM) and verified end-to-end on real sample data. Deferred items split into 9t0/unr/ktq.

title: swissTLM3D vector: global node dedup / shared-vertex topology
description: Slice 1 emits per-feature nodes with no global dedup (mkgmap tolerates coincident nodes). Add coordinate dedup + shared node ids so connected ways share vertices, shrinking output and improving routing topology.
